purpose: Document Katihar's official local land-record custodian, Bihar BhuNaksha discovery, current viewer routes, bounded anonymous requests, and the separation between registry evidence, safe parcel identity, geometry, and runtime qualification.
assessment: Official Katihar district and Bihar Revenue/Land Records sources establish a local land-record custodian and official state cadastral-map service. The current BhuNaksha viewer was inspected successfully: its hierarchy identifies Katihar and its map endpoint returns EPSG:32645 metadata plus a safe native plot id from a bounded map-point request. No full polygon/vector feature was returned, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Katihar district land-record service page and the official Bihar Directorate of Land Records & Survey BhuNaksha service. This establishes service/custodian evidence, not citywide geometry completeness or ownership/title evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Katihar district land-record service and Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral-map service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Katihar hierarchy, Katihar mauza 0062 map metadata, EPSG:32645, one safe native plot identity, and raster WMS behavior.

attempts: Loaded official Katihar English and Hindi land-record pages over TLS (HTTP 200).
Loaded official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms portal over TLS (HTTP 200); confirmed links to Bhu-Naksha and land-record services.
Loaded https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/index.jsp anonymously (HTTP 200), inspected current JavaScript/configuration, and identified REST hierarchy, map-extent, point-selection, and WMS routes.
POSTed /rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel for state=10 and Katihar selections; observed Katihar district code 10, subdivision 01, circle 01, Katihar mauza code 0062, and Cadastral/Revisional map choices.
POSTed /rest/MapInfo/getVVVVExtentGeoref for gisLevels=10,01,01,0062,CS,06,01; received gisCode CS10010100620810601, EPSG:32645, and a bounded sheet extent.

POSTed /rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY at a point inside the tested sheet; received JSON id loP830khRR6MfrOSJRDTEg and plot number 184. Only safe native identity metadata was recorded; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or personal fields were requested.

POSTed /rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY at the exact immutable WUP point after coordinate transformation to EPSG:32645; response was empty because the point was outside the tested sheet extent. This was not treated as citywide absence and the point was not shifted.
Requested bounded WMS PLOT_LIST/GetFeatureInfo output; service returned image/png raster output, not a full vector polygon or JSON feature geometry.
Did not log in, use credentials/private tokens, defeat CAPTCHA/Cloudflare, disable TLS verification, or request unsafe personal/ownership fields.
No sample GeoJSON was created because no full parcel polygon was independently verified.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Run unchanged; transformed point [556953.86, 2825399.82] was outside the tested CS sheet extent and returned no plot.
geometryEvidence.polygonResponse: None; viewer returned raster WMS and point-selection metadata only.

nextStep: Independent serial review of Bihar BhuNaksha vector/geometry export capability and citywide sheet coverage; keep adapter/runtime held until a real safe native ID plus full parcel polygon is independently qualified.
remainingUncertainty: Current vector export behavior, all Katihar cadastral-sheet coverage, urban boundary correspondence, and whether other map instances contain the WUP point remain unverified.
